title: Moreish Puff Menthol Blueberries & Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blueberries & Raspberries from the Moreish Puff Menthol collection is a berry delicious treat with an icy twist. Juicy, sweet Blueberries meet tart, tangy Raspberries on the inhale which is chased by a crisp, cool blast of bracing Menthol for a super-refreshing exhale. This 100ml shortfill bottle is a convenient way to make your favourite e-liquid last longer. It includes an additional 20ml of space, allowing you to add a nicotine shot and tailor the nicotine strength to your preference. For example, by adding two 10ml, 18mg nic shots, you can make 120ml of 3mg strength e-liquid. With a 70VG/30PG ratio, this e-liquid is ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods, and sub-ohm tanks. Shortfills are an excellent choice for vapers who know which e-liquid brands and flavours they enjoy and want to have a steady supply on hand. They provide a practical way to save money by reducing the need for frequent purchases of smaller quantities. Since shortfills typically have a high-VG to PG ratio, they are suitable for use with high-powered devices that consume e-liquid quickly. Having a larger bottle of your favourite e-liquid can help ensure you don't run out too soon. Moreish Puff has become one of the most popular e-liquid brands in the world. Moreish Puff e-liquids are made in the UK from top quality ingredients and their dedication to quality and innovation has seen Moreish Puff produce some of the most exciting e-liquid ranges around, including lines inspired by delicious fruits, summer ciders, creamy milkshakes, iced slushies, classic desserts, sodas, sherbets and even cocktails.
